# arin_whois_net_delegations (Data Source)

List Whois-RWS rdns related to a net registration. References are returned by default; show_details requests expanded records. Parent-network lookups always return a full record in a list. POC role links remain distinct. No API key is sent. Partial responses and referrals are rejected; recognized no-results responses require an existing owner before returning an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_whois_net_delegations" "example" {
  handle       = "NET-192-0-2-0-1"
  show_details = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) ARIN registration handle.

### Optional

- `show_details` (Boolean) Ask ARIN to expand related information inline. Complete XML preserves extra records; any nested truncation is rejected. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `delegations` (Attributes List) Related records ordered deterministically. Distinct POC role links are preserved. Reference responses omit detail-only fields; show_details requests full records. Confirmed no matches produce an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--delegations))
- `whois_xml` (String) Complete relationship response XML, including references, expanded records and extensions. Null for a confirmed empty HTTP 404 response. Links are not followed.

<a id="nestedatt--delegations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `delegations`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (List of String) Ordered lines of comments.
- `ds_records` (Attributes List) ds records returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--delegations--ds_records))
- `name` (String) name returned by ARIN.
- `nameservers` (List of String) nameservers returned by ARIN.
- `poc_functions` (List of String) Sorted POC association function codes. Reference links retain their function; expanded POCs collect functions from inline links to the requested owner.
- `rdap_ref` (String) rdap ref returned by ARIN.
- `ref` (String) ref returned by ARIN.
- `reference_name` (String) reference name returned by ARIN.
- `registration_date` (String) registration date returned by ARIN.
- `related_poc_handle` (String) related poc handle returned by ARIN.
- `related_poc_name` (String) related poc name returned by ARIN.
- `update_date` (String) update date returned by ARIN.

<a id="nestedatt--delegations--ds_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `delegations.ds_records`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (Number) algorithm returned by ARIN.
- `digest` (String) digest returned by ARIN.
- `digest_type` (Number) digest type returned by ARIN.
- `key_tag` (Number) key tag returned by ARIN.
